question: Town C is south of the mid-point of the straight line joining town A and B. Town B is to the East of Town A. Town D is west of town C. Town M is north-east of town B. What is the position of town D with respect to M?
solution:
**Given:**

Town C is south of the mid-point of the straight line joining town A and B.

Town B is to the East of Town A.

Town D is west of town C.

Town M is north-east of town B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d85f1d8d994bc1dfea63dbec55d50b89b1edb5cb48251102ffc01fd984a778ce.png] 

Thus, town D is to southwest of town M.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
